observations: All six actual PNGs were viewed at original resolution. Every raw hash matches the completed receipt; its cleanup confirmation is true. Captions, UTC capture timestamps and the full source SHA are legible.

These are partial-viewport images as declared by their captions. Privacy masks conceal identities, codes, QR and some input or label text; concealed values and checked states are not independently verified visually. No visible secret or benefit QR was observed.
01: Catalogue and money shows all four Payments groups and the explicit Deployment-only and Not integrated statements.
02: Tenders shows Enabled and Cash filters, one matching method out of15 loaded methods, and the native row controls. Method names and search/input text are masked.

03: Devices shows filter labels, All statuses, native loaded counts, box roles and current statuses. Offline, never-reported and waiting-to-be-claimed readings are operational conditions, not classified here as product defects.

04: Configuration shows the Payments groups, the All parks in your reach selection, the eight-of-eight settings count and the Settings by owner heading. The search field and detailed setting cards are not established by this partial frame.

05: Cash-day rows, dates, amounts, Not counted statuses and loaded counts are readable. The Cash days heading and attention-filter label/control are outside the frame, so this image alone does not visually demonstrate the toggle. This framing limit was reported to root before finalization.

06: Settlement heading and the attention-filter label are visible; the checkbox itself is hidden by privacy masking. No-file and terminal not-run readings remain legible. They are retained operational conditions and are not interpreted as newly broken reconciliation.

A filter need not reduce rows when all loaded rows meet its predicate. No reduction is inferred from these frames. This is artifact-only visual/hash review; no browser, database, staging/network action, image retouch or repository change was performed.
